description: News search API via Google News: fresh, time-ordered news results with title, link, source and publish date. Use for news monitoring, daily briefings, brand or competitor alerts and event tracking — what is the latest news about X. Distinct from general web search: news-scoped and recency-first. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.
